levels.surface: عبد الله بن عمر بن سعيد الأشج

notes: «ورواه جماعة» names an unnamed group as the compiler's shaykh; the six names after «عن» are co-transmitters, and «قالوا جميعاً» brings them to أبو أسامة
Ibn Mas'ud is asked and answers inside Masruq's report, and his words are the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6)
